pkgmetadata.longdescription: Builds C, C++, OpenMP, Fortran, libquadmath, libitm and IMCI test programs with a k1om cross compiler, runs them on a Xeon Phi (KNC) card over ssh through the sysroot's own loader, and compares the output with a reference run of Intel's MPSS gcc 5.1.1 and with fixed expected results.
